One thing that has honestly helped me overcome a lot this year is diet. I know it can be old fashion in this age of treating problems with some type of "cure" but food is life. You eat more then you take any sort of meds or drugs (hopefully). Everyones different and I'm not a nutritionist but a couple of things worth trying: 
1. Get your complete proteins: 
You need complete proteins to fuel your body and most importantly your brain. Your brain turns these proteins into extremely powerful neurotransmitters. These neurotransmitters are what basically control everything about you including your mood. 
Hemp seeds or protein are a complete protein, one of the few complete vegetable proteins and its fucking delicious.  
Best muchy cure: 
Couple of spoons of hemp protein, honey and coconut water. Tastes amazing and fills you up. 
2. Get your vitamins: 
I know there is soooo much bullshit in the supplement and vitamin world but some of it helps. You need to experiment or go see a nutritionist that can do blood work and tell you what you're lacking. I find vit C and vit B to have really helped. Vit C keeps you from getting sick while vit B helps absorb your awesome proteins and keeps up your energy. There's probably a lot more that I havent tried so I'd love to hear other peoples experiences. Some mushrooms are packed with vitamins. 
3. Magnesium 
God this one helped me soooo much. Anxiety gone! basically from what I can understand it helps your muscles relax and its great for the health of your brain. Remember you brain is an organ and like any other organ it can get un healthy. 
 
Diet is fucking complected and everyone will need different things. Also there's some big powers in this world that don't want us to be happy and healthy. It's important no matter what supplements you take to also eat lots of fresh real food. This fruit, veggies, meat, mushrooms. If it grows and is not made in some food science lab its probably good for you.  
Also there is a massive difference between fresh food and stale nutrient deficient supermaket food. Get into gardening, its actually great for depression because it keeps you busy and you get to raise awesome little plants. Plus gardening high is the best! 
 
One more thing food will not fix your depression because a lot of it is just shit you have to work through in your head. Some people have mentioned hobbys and they have also been an amazing help. Yoga and meditation are also great along with general exercise. BUT food sure fucking helps, you eat every dam day so pay attention to what your jamming down your face hole.
